name: web_search
description: Look something up on the internet: facts about a named person, place, product or event, the latest news, scores, results, prices, release dates, anything current that FRED cannot know by itself. Returns a short digest to put into one or two spoken sentences.

query.description: just the subject to look up, a few words (for example 'Arijit Singh new album'), never the whole sentence and nothing personal

kind.description: auto (default) uses news sources for latest/today/score wording; news forces them; web forces ordinary search

examples: search the web for the new iPhone price
I mean search for it online
no, look it up on the web
can you search the internet for that
look up Arijit Singh on the internet
what is the latest news about the election
who won the match last night
google when the next Marvel movie comes out
find out how old Shah Rukh Khan is
what is in the news today
search online for the grade 10 board exam dates
search for the exam date sheet online
find the dates for this online
not_for: anything about the user or their files
opening a website or an app
